"""Test dangerous command detection in core_tools.run_shell."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)))

from tools.core_tools import run_shell


def test(command, should_block):
    result = run_shell(command)
    blocked = "[拦截]" in result
    status = "✅" if blocked == should_block else "❌"
    print(f"{status} {command!r:50s} → {'blocked' if blocked else 'allowed'}  (expected: {'block' if should_block else 'allow'})")
    return blocked == should_block


if __name__ == "__main__":
    passed = 0
    total = 0

    # --- Must be BLOCKED ---
    for cmd in [
        "rm -rf /",
        "rm -rf /tmp",
        "rm -fr /etc",
        "rm -r -f /var",
        "rm -f -r /home",
        "rm --recursive --force /",
        "rm -rfv /boot",
        "dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/null",
        "format C:",
        "mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb1",
        "fdisk /dev/sda",
        ":(){ :|:& };:",
        "chmod 777 /",
        "rd /s /q C:\\Windows",
        "rmdir /s Q:\\Temp",
        "del /f /q C:\\pagefile.sys",
        "shutdown /s /t 0",
        "reboot",
    ]:
        total += 1
        if test(cmd, True):
            passed += 1

    # --- Should NOT be blocked (safe commands) ---
    for cmd in [
        "ls -la",
        "echo hello world",
        "git status",
        "python --version",
        "dir",
        "mkdir new_folder",
        "cat file.txt",
        "cp source.txt dest.txt",
        "rm file.txt",          # rm without -r/-f is safe
        "del temp.txt",         # del without /f /q /s is safe
        "whoami",
        "ping 8.8.8.8",
    ]:
        total += 1
        if test(cmd, False):
            passed += 1

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Results: {passed}/{total} passed")
    if passed == total:
        print("🎉 All tests passed!")
    else:
        print("⚠️  Some tests failed.")
        sys.exit(1)
